tools.name: search_themes
tools.description: Search public Tailthemes metadata by name, description, tags, or category.

tools.name: get_theme
tools.description: Get a theme's complete public manifest, including tokens, plus its AGENTS.md and README.md.

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Read one manifest-declared component, page, theme.css, AGENTS.md, or README.md file. Paid theme source needs an active license.

tools.name: download_theme
tools.description: Get a theme's zip download URL. Free themes download directly with no key or account. Paid themes need an active license: buy at the theme page, then call again with license_key and the ready-to-fetch URL comes back. For a paid theme that has a free HTML edition, the answer also carries that edition

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "download_theme" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get a theme's zip download URL. Free themes download directly with no key or account. Paid themes need an active license: buy at the theme page, then call again with license_key and the ready-to-fetch URL comes back." → after: "Get a theme's zip download URL. remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
